rules.statement: A party's failure to participate in the trial under the Partition Law does not preclude them from challenging a final partition scheme.
rules.supporting_quote: 1. The Partition Law makes no prohibition against a party who had failed to participate at the trial. In the absence of a specific prohibition it is not possible to presume any such prohibition. 2. The order of the District Judge had deprived the respondent from making his objections to the Scheme of Partition. - 3.
